summary: Nez Perce NF lookout: 75-ft crow's nest in 1927, log cabin in 1929, pole tower in 1945; destroyed 1960. Sources disagree on the 1945 tower's size.

facts.design: 1945 pole tower with L-4 cab per two sites (40 ft), or 50-ft L-6 with gable roof per the Forest Service list; earlier 75-ft crow's nest (1927) and log cabin (1929)
facts.status_note: Destroyed 1960; the FFLA list marks the tower gone

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site Drive-Up. The tower is gone and no source describes the site now.

events.note: Ted Oliver is the one known staff entry

evidence.supports: 75-foot crow's nest in 1927, log cabin in 1929, 40-foot pole L-4 tower in 1945, destroyed 1960
evidence.quote: 1927: 75' crows nest. 1929: log cabin. 1945: 40' pole L-4 tower. Destroyed 1960.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two sites give a 40-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab for 1945; the Forest Service list gives a 50-foot L-6 tower with a gable roof. The design field keeps the two-site reading and height_m is left unset.

sources.title: Nez Perce National Forest Lookouts
sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Nez Perce National Forest

notes_for_editor: The 1960 destruction year is given by the three sources that date it (firelookout.com, the Forest Service list and Idaho Fire Lookouts); the FFLA list marks the tower gone without a date. The 1945 tower's height and cab type do not agree across sources. The Drive-Up tag on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page is recorded as written, not as evidence of current access. No photo added. No source describes the site now.
